description: Use this when an authenticated SIMcloud user asks to send a confirmed South African mobile data bundle. Call list_data_products first and use an available network and sell value. This spends wallet funds and queues an irreversible external transaction. Never automatically retry an ambiguous result. Duplicate same-MSISDN-and-amount requests inside 5 minutes return HTTP 409.

amount.description: Exact data bundle sell value returned by list_data_products.

msisdn.description: South African mobile number to recharge, for example 0821234567 or +27821234567.

network.description: Supported South African data network name or SIMcloud internal code returned by list_data_products.

reference.description: User or system reference for this data order.

name: create_data_order

ok.description: Whether the proxied SIMcloud API request returned a 2xx response.

status.description: HTTP status returned by the SIMcloud API, or 0 when no HTTP response was received.

title: Create data order
